notes.title: AI-deal-Rays Ver1.1
notes.notes:
[p][i]AI-deal-Rays[/i] has been updated to Ver1.1.
This version introduces the Sylpheed Encyclopedia mode (“ENCYCROPEDIA”) and the “STORY” difficulty setting.[/p][p][/p][p][b]About the ENCYCROPEDIA[/b]
A new “ENCYCROPEDIA” button has been added to the title screen.
You can view detailed settings and status parameters of all Sylpheeds that appear in the story.
Enhanced versions are also included, so you can follow the progression of how X2 was strengthened throughout the story.
Additionally, Cluster Drain, which had strict activation conditions in the main game, can be triggered freely in this mode.
Please note: when the graphic quality is set to 2 or lower, effects will be simplified, so we recommend viewing with quality level 3 or higher.[/p][p][/p][p][b]STORY Difficulty[/b]
A new difficulty setting, “STORY,” has been added to the action parts.
This option is easier than “NORMAL,” intended for players who primarily wish to enjoy the story.
Please note that this setting can only be changed from the title screen.[/p][p][/p][p][b]New Branch: Upscaler Disabled[/b]
We have confirmed that in some environments, loading the XeSS plugin may cause crashes.
As an emergency measure, a new branch that disables the upscaler has been created.
If you are experiencing startup crashes, please try the “upscalerdisabled” branch.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your continued support.[/p]
